events.description: The drill-down: the whole tile becomes a button that opens the detail.
events.name: onPress

props.description: What the figure counts, shown above it.
props.name: label

props.description: The figure: a number, formatted in the locale, or text already formatted.
props.name: value

props.description: A short tag beside the figure; nothing is drawn when it is empty.
props.name: badge

props.description: The change against the previous period as a fraction (0.12 is up 12%), drawn as a `TrendChip`.
props.name: trend

props.description:
The previous period's figure: a muted "Previous period" line under the figure, formatted like it, and, when
`trend` is left out and `value` is a number, the trend worked out from the two.
props.name: previousValue

props.description: The direction that is better for the trend's colour; `up` by default.
props.name: better

props.description: What the trend compares with: "vs last month".
props.name: comparison

props.description: The recent values, oldest first, drawn as an area sparkline under the figure.
props.name: sparkline

props.description: The goal for a numeric `value`: a bar shows how far along it is.
props.name: target

props.description: The drill-down button's description ("Open Revenue" by default); its name is what the tile shows.
props.name: pressLabel
